context.context: SOUTHAMPTON, England -- The image emphasizes the state-of-the-art fitness facilities available on the Harmony of the Seas, the largest cruise ship ever built. As part of Royal Caribbean's commitment to leisure and wellness, the Vitality at Sea fitness center is designed to provide guests with a comprehensive workout experience while at sea. The Harmony of the Seas sets sail on its maiden voyage soon, and the exclusive access has allowed media outlets like USA TODAY to provide an early look at its accommodations—including luxurious cabins and a fitness center equipped to meet the needs of all passengers wishing to maintain their fitness regimes during their cruise. The modern fitness center reflects the growing trend in cruise travel, where guests are looking for more amenities that support healthy living options, even while traveling.
